_description: Grounded multi-turn chat query-rewrite eval (Surface A, docs/specs/grounded-agentic-chat.md §9.1). Each case is a conversation HISTORY + a FOLLOW-UP whose references the control-layer rewrite must resolve; the score is gold-chunk recall@k of hybrid_search on the REWRITTEN query (retrieval-isolated — no rerank/LLM in the inner metric).
_doc_note: Source documents stay LOCAL (tests/eval-data/README.md); only this case set ships. `relevant_chunk_ids` are GOLD chunks from THIS reference vault (CCNA SRWE modules + NIST SP 800-207), resolved live 2026-06-01. Re-resolve against your own index if your vault differs.
_metric: mean_recall = mean over cases of gold_chunk_recall(hybrid_search(rewritten_query)[:k], relevant_chunk_ids, k). A case < 1.0 means the rewrite failed to surface a gold chunk for that follow-up — the A-1.5 follow-up-resolution gap (the trigger for prompt tuning, spec §9.1).

_baseline_2026_06_01._note: rewrite_followup/v1 on the Qwen3.5-4B orchestrator. Every follow-up's referent resolved ('it'->Spanning Tree Protocol / DHCPv4 / NIST SP 800-207 zero trust) and every gold chunk retrieved within top-50. mean_recall=1.0 — no A-1.5 gap on this set. NB the model judged is_followup=false on these (the rewrite still resolved the referent, which is what recall measures); is_followup accuracy is a separate, non-gated signal.
